_comment: HYBRID — OpenRouter for everyday tools, local models for the audit.
Read the grading block before using this. grading.backend defaults to
'openrouter' when the key is ABSENT, so omitting it silently ships every
graded tool input and output to the cloud. It is set explicitly below.
The /local-audit sweeper still runs: it checks that its own review
dimensions are local, not that your config is free of cloud backends. Pass
--strict if you want it to refuse whenever a remote backend is declared at
all. Note the sweeper talks only to backends.ollama.url regardless — it
imports nothing from ollama_mcp and has no code path to a cloud host.

openrouter._comment: api_key_env keeps the secret out of this file. Prefer it over api_key, which stores the key in plaintext and travels into every backup you take.

routes._comment: A bare string uses default_backend. Use the object form to send one tool elsewhere.

grading._comment: MUST be set explicitly. Absent 'backend' means openrouter, which sends graded inputs and outputs off-machine.

swarm._comment: Kept fully local so /local-audit runs. Prefixing a dimension with 'openrouter/' makes the sweeper refuse.

consensus_candidates._comment: Consensus is a fine place to mix cloud and local — disagreement between a cloud and a local model is informative. This is separate from the audit.
